comparisons.peer_topic: 2025 Issuance of Series Z Preferred Stock
comparisons.peer_summary: In January 2025, the firm issued 76,000 shares of Series Z 6.85% Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, which has a $25,000 liquidation preference, is redeemable at the firm's option starting February 10, 2030, and pays semi-annual dividends at 6.85% per annum until that date, thereafter resetting to 2.461% plus the five-year treasury rate.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs disclosed the issuance of a new series of fixed-rate reset non-cumulative preferred stock in early 2025 (January for GS Series Z, February for JPM Series OO). While JPM specified a total dollar amount ($3.0 billion), GS disclosed the specific number of shares issued (76,000) with a $25,000 liquidation preference per share, resulting in a similar $1.9 billion total value. Both issuances are recent capital raising activities using similar instrument structures.
